name: nonApi_markKennelChatRead
description: THE read mark for one of a kennel's two chat threads (E9.F1.S33), shared by hcapp_markKennelChatRead and hcportal_markKennelChatRead. Writes the (UserId, KennelId, MessageType) EventMessageBadgeCounts row at the thread's current maximum. No rowset; the error OUTPUTs say what went wrong (logged here).

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel whose thread (EventMessage rows with KennelId set and EventId NULL) was read. NULL: errorCode 1901, errorType 2.

parameters.name: kennelThread
parameters.description: Which of the kennel's two threads (E9.F1.S33): 0 (default) the general chat, 1 the private Mismanagement chat (MessageType 100). The read mark is the (UserId, KennelId, MessageType) row and the max is of that thread only. 1 for a caller not in HC6.UserInKennelMismanagement, or an unknown value: errorCode 1913, errorType 13 (logged).

parameters.name: errorCode
parameters.description: OUTPUT: NULL on success; 1901 no kennel, 1913 not in mismanagement / unknown thread, 1933 unexpected.

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts on (KennelId, UserId, Removed = 0): UPDATE LastSequenceCount = COALESCE(MAX(MessageSequenceCount), 0), LastReadAt = GETUTCDATE(), LastReadMessageId; or INSERT (UserId, KennelId, LastSequenceCount, LastReadAt, LastReadMessageId) with id/createdAt/updatedAt from defaults (lines 66-81)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on NULL kennelId and on the CATCH path (after ROLLBACK)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
